gazetteer_names_needed.name: Butana
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: plain between the Nile, the Atbara and the Blue Nile in central-eastern Sudan, the Abdallab vassal territory; named in the /ledger/2 text only (the region spec uses River Nile and Khartoum)

gaps.what: year of the Taqali vassalage (c. 1665, confidence 1): the Funj page gives only Badi II's reign 1644/5-1681 and the Kingdom of Taqali page dates the state itself to tradition (early 16th century) or 1750-1780 by some scholars
year of the loss of the Tigre (c. 1790, confidence 1): the Funj page says only 'second half of the 18th century' and names 'the rising naib'

eastern Kordofan's western line (30 E) is the author's reading: the Darfur page says only 'eastern Kordofan via the Ghudiyat'; the Funj page's extent sentence ('west to Kordofan and the Nuba Mountains') is read as influence
the Funj conquest of north-western Eritrea in the late 16th century (Funj page) is not entered as a gain: Cliopatria's outline holds only 2,529 km2 of Gash Barka
makuria /ledger/8 (af-01-a) names banu-kanz as taker of Dongola in 1365; the Banu Kanz and Makuria pages do not say who held Dongola 1366-1523 (funj-sultanate now names nobody for its 1523 gain)

problems: Only funj-sultanate was touched (verdict fail); ethiopian-empire (thin), ifat-sultanate (fix), adal-sultanate (fix) and makuria-kingdom (pass) were left as instructed.

funj-sultanate: Kordofan (264,533 km2 of Cliopatria's 592,545 km2 shape) is cut west of 30 E for 1504-1733, kept as eastern-Kordofan influence until 1734, absent 1734-1754 and whole from 1755; new keyframes funj-sultanate_1734 and funj-sultanate_1755 lie inside Cliopatria's 1636 range (1636-1768), so a renderer must take the latest keyframe starting on or before the year.

funj-sultanate: the Abdallab and Taqali vassal tints now run to 1821 (Abdallab and Taqali pages) while the 1802 loss and the 1820 keyframe describe direct rule only (Funj page: authority 'limited to the Gezira for good' after 1802).

Cross-dossier: makuria (af-01-a) /ledger/8 names banu-kanz for the 1365 loss of Dongola, which no opened page supports; funj-sultanate's 1523 gain names nobody. muhammad-ali-dynasty (me-10) and sultanate-of-darfur (af-03) still owe mirrors for 1821 and Kordofan c. 1785 (and the Darfur side of the Musabba'at events).
